mechanism_narrative: TRANSIT has recovered monotonically from -41.6 to -34.7 across the four snapshot weeks. Each week of transit recovery restores discretionary trips that terminate in shops, restaurants and gyms, so RETAIL_REC continues climbing toward baseline over the next four weeks.

failure_condition: The next-28-day mean of RETAIL_REC is at or below the last-28-day mean of -27.3 even though weekly TRANSIT means keep rising above -34.7.

evidence_refs: fact:RESIDENTIAL declined from 10.6 to 8.3 over four snapshot weeks
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC shows no increase within two weeks after RESIDENTIAL prints below +8.0 percent, or RESIDENTIAL rebounds above +10 while RETAIL_REC still rises.

TRANSIT is climbing but WORKPLACES fell to -32.3; once the workplace dip reverses, the joint rise propagates into retail footfall within four weeks.

regime_hint: post-Omicron reopening with partial office return
failure_condition: In weeks where TRANSIT and WORKPLACES rise together, RETAIL_REC still fails to exceed its pre-joint-rise level within four weeks.
